# Reference

The rest of the book is for looking things up in.

The glossary defines every term this book set in bold. The error index maps
every error message the book explains to the page that explains it. The cheat
sheet is two pages and is meant to be printed on its own. The dataset index
lists every external source, with the address in full and the date it was last
checked.
